newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank tender rate unchanged at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank tender rate unchanged at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Finland on Tuesday injected 1.70 billion markka ($322.2 million) of spot liquidity in an auction of one-month paper at an unchanged 3.00 percent tender rate.
Before the opening, the central bank forecast a spot liquidity surplus of 3.2 billion markka. The required daily balance for banks was 5.95 billion markka.

The Bank of Finland's tender rate, its chief monetary policy tool, has been unchanged since it was lowered to 3.00 percent from 3.10 percent on October 9, 1996. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-9-6805 0245, news@reuters.fi ($ = 5.276 Finnish Markka)
